scope: Qwen4Exp gfx1151 selected Q5_1 down projection plus routed weighted-sum fusion

implementation.change: One physical64 CTA per hidden output processes selected route slots in original order, preserves every Q5 logical partial/reduction, rounds every route result to BF16, then replays weighted_sum_out_kernel's fmaf(BF16, F32 weight, accumulator) chain exactly.

paired_complete_model.protocol: one residency; separate MoE graph-cache keys during screening; warm strict+candidate; counterbalanced S/C/C/S/S/C; every row reset + p1 + 8 warm + 32 measured greedy tokens; full-logit SHA at every step

kernel_trace.command: HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_Q5_FUSED_WEIGHTED=1 rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-file /tmp/q5fusedweighted -- uv run python /tmp/qwen4exp_decode32_profile.py
kernel_trace.note: The environment flag existed only in the uncommitted screen and is removed by promotion; strict measurements come from the immediately preceding exact-Q5-t64 trace.

decision: Promote as exact gfx1151 c1 default. H=2560 provides enough output-column CTAs for route-slot serialization, removes one weighted-sum launch per Q5 layer/token, and improves complete graph decode.
